name: API Mock
author: duncanireri
description: Local WireMock-style API & webhook mock server, driven from the Omarchy bar: point it at a JSON file of stubs, pick a port, watch requests live.

barWidget.description: Start/stop a local mock server, choose a mappings file, watch matched and unmatched requests as they arrive.

schema.label: Mappings file or folder
schema.description: A WireMock-style JSON file, or a folder of *.json files. ~ is expanded.

schema.label: Bind address
schema.description: 127.0.0.1 keeps the mock private to this machine; 0.0.0.0 exposes it on the network.

schema.label: Start the server when the shell starts
